title: C¹ non-increasing radial cutoff: 1 on (−∞,1], 0 on [A²,∞) (step 1 of the cylinder-monotonicity proof)
statement: For every real number A > 1 there is a function φ : ℝ → ℝ that is C¹, non-increasing, takes values in [0,1], and satisfies φ(s) = 1 for every s ≤ 1 and φ(s) = 0 for every s ≥ A².
lean_statement: ∀ A : ℝ, 1 < A → ∃ φ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 φ ∧ Antitone φ ∧ (∀ s, 0 ≤ φ s ∧ φ s ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ s, s ≤ 1 → φ s = 1) ∧ (∀ s, A ^ 2 ≤ s → φ s = 0)
